verdict.rationale: Ente Auth's docs say it natively supports bulk imports from many 2FA providers, naming 2FAS, Aegis, andOTP (including encrypted backups), Bitwarden, Google Authenticator, LastPass, Proton and Raivo, with a plaintext-format fallback for others. A hands-on user also reports that moving from Aegis was very easy. Missing for 10: Authy migration needs a conversion step to Ente's plaintext format, and Microsoft Authenticator still requires scanning each QR code by hand.
